servers.name: ZynoxSMP
servers.about:
Welcome to ZynoxSMP!

A friendly Minecraft Bedrock Survival SMP where you can explore, build, mine, trade and create your own story.

Build your base, make friends, explore the world and become a legend.

Join ZynoxSMP and start your adventure!

servers.name: Zynox Enhanced
servers.description: An enhanced Bedrock world powered by Better on Bedrock and additional content.
